verdict.rationale: Feitian's docs show port variety: a BioPass model (K26) with USB Type-A/Type-C, a Lightning plus USB-C dual-interface key, USB+NFC keys, and the MultiPass USB/NFC/BLE key. That covers the USB-C and USB-A part of the story. The evidence never mentions keychain or low-profile nano form factors, so the carry-style half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: any evidence of keychain or nano/low-profile models, a clear model-by-model lineup of USB-A versus USB-C variants, independent or hands-on corroboration.
